## Source: amazon-inspector (c963e2aeb6a7a16e64f855c57cd12673b8719223ceec141eabf4bd0df606e51c)
pipegrip 0.1.0 ships a small Python package with no observed install-time or import-time network activity, no credential or filesystem secret reads, no subprocess execution of fetched content, and no lifecycle hooks performing privileged actions. No exfiltration, dropper, silent-relay, backdoor, or self-propagation mechanism is present in the artifact.

## Source: kam193 (69da6e2696ea51627e314534617b3a5507896dd6375f600ae4a71d84ace79609)
This campaign consists of similar loader packages, which provide executing code from a given URL. While they do not contain the malicious payload and the usage remains unknown, they are clearly a coordinated campaign to place multiple deceptive ways to load malicious code.
